text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe will soon be receiving electricity from Mozambique, With the completion in the middle of this year of a power line from the Cahora Bassa dam on the Zambezi river, says Deputy Minister of Mineral Resources and Energy Castigo Langa.

- President Jorge Sampaio of Portugal addressed the Mozambican parliament in Maputo on Tuesday and offered to help in the creation of municipalities through multi-party elections in November this year.
